items.raw_excerpt: The municipality of Alijó plans to implement a tourist tax of two euros per overnight stay and two euros per arrival by hotel boat, to reinvest in tourism and support Douro winegrowers, it was announced.
items.summary_en: The town of Alijó in Portugal plans to charge tourists two euros for each night they sleep. Hotel boats that bring guests to the town will pay two euros for each arrival. The money will go to local tourism and help the grape growers of the Douro valley.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 알리조 마을이 손님 한 명에게 숙박 한 박에 2유로를 받는 관광객 세제를 만들려 한다. 호텔 보트로 손님을 데려오는 배도 한 번에 2유로를 낸다. 이 돈은 관광에 재투자하고 두루 계곡 포도주 농부를 돕는 데 쓴다.
items.title_en: Portuguese town Alijó works on a tourist tax
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 알리조 마을, 관광객 숙박세 도입 검토
items.title_original: Portugal municipality working on implementing tourist tax

items.raw_excerpt: Ethan Espinoza y Ariel Cáceres se inscribieron en el marcador de la victoria 2-0 de Deportes Concepción sobre Curicó Unido en el Estadio "Ester Roa" por la vuelta de los octavos de final en la Copa Chile, en una serie que finalizó 6-0 a favor del elenco "lila" en el global.
items.summary_en: Deportes Concepcion beat Curicó Unido 2-0 in Collao in the Copa Chile round of 16. Ethan Espinoza and Ariel Cáceres scored the goals. Concepcion won the tie 6-0 on aggregate.
items.summary_ko: 코파 칠레 16강 라운드에서 데포르테스 코셉션이 쿠리코 우니도를 2-0으로 이겼다. 에탄 에스피나와 아리엘 카세레스가 득점에 성공했다. 코셉션은 총점 6-0으로 두 번째 경기 없이 승부를 갈랐다.
items.title_en: Two Local Players Led Concepcion Win
items.title_ko: 코셉션 원정 승리 앞선 두 선수
items.title_original: Copa Chile: Espinoza y Cáceres lideraron la victoria de Concepción sobre Curicó en Collao

items.raw_excerpt: Pacote com 30 requerimentos protocolados na Câmara Municipal exige soluções urgentes para limpeza, iluminação e segurança.
items.summary_en: City council members in Curitiba, Brazil, filed 30 formal requests about public squares in 14 neighborhoods. They say the parks need better cleaning, lights, and safety. The city has to answer soon.

items.title_en: Curitiba lawmakers want better parks in 14 areas

items.raw_excerpt: The slow jogging trend was originally developed by a Japanese researcher named Hiroaki Tanaka.
items.summary_en: Slow jogging is a soft way to begin exercising. A Japanese researcher named Hiroaki Tanaka came up with the idea. It puts less strain on the body than fast running, so beginners can keep it up for a long time.
items.summary_ko: 천천히 조깅은 운동을 처음 시작하는 사람에게 잘 맞는 운동이다. 일본 연구자 다나카 히로아키가 처음 제안한 방법이다. 빠르게 뛰는 것보다 몸에 부담이 적고 오래 할 수 있다는 점이 장점이다.
items.title_en: Slow jogging: an easy start for beginners
items.title_ko: 천천히 조깅, 운동 처음 시작하는 사람에게 딱 좋은 방법
items.title_original: ‘Slow jogging’: the perfect trend for people who want to get into exercise

items.raw_excerpt: Energy policy has changed greatly since South Australia was left in darkness exactly 10 years ago today — but if there is a universal constant of the energy debate, it is that there is always friction over electricity.
items.summary_en: Ten years ago today, all of South Australia lost power for many hours. Energy rules have changed a lot since then. But people still argue about electricity, so the old debate is still very much alive.
items.summary_ko: 10년 전 오늘, 호주 남부주는 여러 시간 동안 전력을 잃었습니다. 그 뒤 에너지 제도는 크게 달라졌습니다. 하지만 여전히 전력을 두고 논쟁이 이어져 오래된 논쟁이 지금도 살아 있습니다.
items.title_en: South Australia's big blackout was 10 years ago, and the power fight is still on
items.title_ko: 남부주 정전 10년, 전력 논쟁은 아직도 끝나지 않았다
items.title_original: SA's statewide blackout was 10 years ago — but electricity debate is still live

items.raw_excerpt: Vanuatu has signed an international declaration ensuring children and young people have a greater say in climate decision-making.
items.summary_en: Vanuatu has signed an international declaration. It gives children and young people a bigger say in climate decisions. The pact was signed in New Zealand.

items.raw_excerpt: So far, scientists have identified more than 1,300 species of sea spiders.
items.summary_en: Scientists found two new kinds of sea spiders along the coast of Canada. These small sea animals have long legs and very thin bodies. People now know more than 1,300 kinds of sea spiders.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 캐나다 해안에서 바다 거미 신종 두 종을 찾아냈다. 이 작은 바다 생물은 다리가 길고 몸이 아주 가늘다. 지금까지 확인된 바다 거미는 1,300종을 넘는다.

items.title_original: Scientists discover two new species of sea spiders along Canadian coastline

items.raw_excerpt: Kim Birrell downs compatriot Maya Joint to claim her first WTA title, but loses her No1 ranking as another Australian performs well in Singapore.
items.summary_en: Kim Birrell won her first WTA title in Singapore. She beat her fellow Australian Maya Joint in the final. But another Australian climbed past her, so Birrell lost the top spot in her home country.

items.summary_en: Everton coach Walter Ribonetto praised how his players answered. The first game of the tie was stopped and later played again at the National Stadium.

items.raw_excerpt: How can we take the edge off the daylight savings transition?
items.summary_en: New Zealand changes its clocks again. We look at how an extra hour of daylight or missing an hour of sleep affects daily life. The piece asks whether the shift is worth the trouble it causes.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드가 또 시계를 바꾼다. 서머타임으로 한 시간이 늘어날 때와 잠을 한 시간 덜 잘 때 몸과 일상에 어떤 차이가 생기는지 살펴본다. 한 시간이 정말 바꿀 만한 변화를 만들지 묻는다.
items.title_en: Daylight Saving: Does One Hour Really Matter?

items.title_original: Daylight saving: Does an hour really make a difference?

items.raw_excerpt: For budding F&B entrepreneurs, temporary spaces serve as a place to test their concepts and to learn the realities of running a business.
items.summary_en: Some food and drink founders in Singapore rent kitchens and small spaces for a short time. They use these places to test their dishes and learn how a real food business runs. The rent can be high and the risk is big, but many still try it.
